services.name: Salmon Fishing
services.desc: Our winter Sekiu Salmon fishing starts February 16 and ends April 10, 2015. This is an excellent winter Chinook Salmon fishing opportunity. Excel Fishing Charters will be offering fishing charters for this 2015 winter season. Sekiu has some of the best Blackmouth fishing in the entire Puget Sound and Strait of Juan de Fuca. This season, the limit for this fishery has been increased to two Chinook salmon per person! Only hatchery fish can be retained. Take advantage of our off-season policy of not mixing parties on Sekiu Salmon fishing charters at Sekiu, Washington. You can have the entire boat with as few as two fishermen. services.name: Marine Eco Tours
services.desc: Discover the beauty of Cape Flattery from the water. Encounters with sea life may include sea otters, a vast array of birds, and perhaps whales, including Gray or Humpback and occasionally Orcas. Venture from the Strait of Juan de Fuca to the Pacific Ocean while marveling at the cliffs, caves, sea stacks, including the Fuca Pillar at Cape Flattery, as well as other rock formations of the Olympic Peninsula in the Pacific Northwest. Tatoosh Island at Cape Flattery is a refuge to many sea birds and also the home to one of the oldest lighthouses on the west coast. blurb: Excel Fishing Charters offers saltwater fishing trips in Neah Bay and Sekiu for species including Salmon, Halibut, Ling Cod, and Bottom Fish. Trips are aboard a safe, fully equipped 26-foot boat called the "Captain Crosby" with ample seating and fishing room. Captain Tom Burlingame has over 30 years of experience and is fully licensed and insured.
